{
  "cells": [
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "8eYZBo6Pe_30"
      },
      "source": [
        "# Hyperparameter Tuning for a Text Classifier\n",
        "**Goal:** Tune a TF-IDF + LinearSVC pipeline using Grid Search and Random Search, and report the optimal parameters.\n",
        "**Dataset:** 20 Newsgroups (4 categories)  \n",
        "**Metric:** Macro F1-score"
      ],
      "id": "8eYZBo6Pe_30"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "HB2PHWa0e_3_"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "import time\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "from scipy.stats import loguniform\n",
        "from sklearn.datasets import fetch_20newsgroups\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV\n",
        "from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer\n",
        "from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC\n",
        "from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix, accuracy_score, f1_score\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)"
      ],
      "id": "HB2PHWa0e_3_"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "YNXgrpk4e_4E"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 1. Load Data"
      ],
      "id": "YNXgrpk4e_4E"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "t1KKWRYPe_4G",
        "outputId": "cba797f5-4751-4527-9e04-547e8c972ba9"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Samples: 3899 | Classes: ['comp.graphics', 'rec.sport.hockey', 'sci.space', 'talk.politics.mideast']\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "cats = ['sci.space', 'rec.sport.hockey', 'comp.graphics', 'talk.politics.mideast']\n",
        "data = fetch_20newsgroups(subset='all', categories=cats,\n",
        "                          remove=('headers','footers','quotes'), random_state=42)\n",
        "X, y = data.data, data.target\n",
        "print(\"Samples:\", len(X), \"| Classes:\", data.target_names)"
      ],
      "id": "t1KKWRYPe_4G"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ChZ84e0Ie_4I"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 2. Train/Test Split (test set is touched only at the end)"
      ],
      "id": "ChZ84e0Ie_4I"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "BJO2ySYje_4K",
        "outputId": "01d9e5e4-ecca-4be8-c2a8-a014269cf3cb"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "3119 780\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42)\n",
        "print(len(X_train), len(X_test))"
      ],
      "id": "BJO2ySYje_4K"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "YryPLWZRe_4M"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 3. Baseline (default parameters, no tuning)"
      ],
      "id": "YryPLWZRe_4M"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "pUWKUIhbe_4N",
        "outputId": "4ab39edb-66ca-44d4-dbde-9eb69b22f0cd"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Baseline  Accuracy: 0.9269  Macro-F1: 0.9278\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "pipe = Pipeline([\n",
        "    ('tfidf', TfidfVectorizer(lowercase=True, stop_words='english')),\n",
        "    ('clf', LinearSVC(max_iter=5000))\n",
        "])\n",
        "t = time.time()\n",
        "pipe.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "base_pred = pipe.predict(X_test)\n",
        "base_acc = accuracy_score(y_test, base_pred)\n",
        "base_f1 = f1_score(y_test, base_pred, average='macro')\n",
        "print(f\"Baseline  Accuracy: {base_acc:.4f}  Macro-F1: {base_f1:.4f}\")"
      ],
      "id": "pUWKUIhbe_4N"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "9X4TlDlEe_4P"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 4. Grid Search"
      ],
      "id": "9X4TlDlEe_4P"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "SInsDtWTe_4R",
        "outputId": "e180ecbe-091f-4f2e-fd20-6c97b0e1ac24"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Fitting 3 folds for each of 36 candidates, totalling 108 fits\n",
            "Grid best params: {'clf__C': 0.1, 'tfidf__max_df': 0.75, 'tfidf__min_df': 1, 'tfidf__ngram_range': (1, 2)}\n",
            "Grid best CV F1: 0.9118 | Time: 133.8s\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "param_grid = {\n",
        "    'tfidf__max_df': [0.75, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
        "    'tfidf__ngram_range': [(1,1), (1,2)],\n",
        "    'tfidf__min_df': [1, 2],\n",
        "    'clf__C': [0.1, 1, 10]\n",
        "}\n",
        "grid = GridSearchCV(pipe, param_grid, cv=3, scoring='f1_macro', n_jobs=-1, verbose=1)\n",
        "t = time.time()\n",
        "grid.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "grid_time = time.time() - t\n",
        "print(\"Grid best params:\", grid.best_params_)\n",
        "print(f\"Grid best CV F1: {grid.best_score_:.4f} | Time: {grid_time:.1f}s\")"
      ],
      "id": "SInsDtWTe_4R"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "OHSqE2S5e_4T"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 5. Random Search"
      ],
      "id": "OHSqE2S5e_4T"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "6Euzqw56e_4U",
        "outputId": "fb107825-07f2-4a00-b20f-334da589f553"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Fitting 3 folds for each of 20 candidates, totalling 60 fits\n",
            "Random best params: {'clf__C': np.float64(5.408216580718498), 'tfidf__max_df': 1.0, 'tfidf__min_df': 1, 'tfidf__ngram_range': (1, 3)}\n",
            "Random best CV F1: 0.9099 | Time: 83.6s\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "param_dist = {\n",
        "    'tfidf__max_df': [0.6, 0.75, 0.9, 1.0],\n",
        "    'tfidf__ngram_range': [(1,1), (1,2), (1,3)],\n",
        "    'tfidf__min_df': [1, 2, 3, 5],\n",
        "    'clf__C': loguniform(1e-2, 1e2)\n",
        "}\n",
        "rand = RandomizedSearchCV(pipe, param_dist, n_iter=20, cv=3, scoring='f1_macro',\n",
        "                          n_jobs=-1, random_state=42, verbose=1)\n",
        "t = time.time()\n",
        "rand.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "rand_time = time.time() - t\n",
        "print(\"Random best params:\", rand.best_params_)\n",
        "print(f\"Random best CV F1: {rand.best_score_:.4f} | Time: {rand_time:.1f}s\")"
      ],
      "id": "6Euzqw56e_4U"
    },

      "source": [
        "results = []\n",
        "for name, s, tm in [('Grid Search', grid, grid_time), ('Random Search', rand, rand_time)]:\n",
        "    pred = s.best_estimator_.predict(X_test)\n",
        "    results.append({'Method': name,\n",
        "                    'Combinations tried': len(s.cv_results_['params']),\n",
        "                    'Best CV F1': round(s.best_score_, 4),\n",
        "                    'Test Accuracy': round(accuracy_score(y_test, pred), 4),\n",
        "                    'Test Macro-F1': round(f1_score(y_test, pred, average='macro'), 4),\n",
        "                    'Time (s)': round(tm, 1)})\n",
        "results.append({'Method': 'Baseline (no tuning)', 'Combinations tried': 1, 'Best CV F1': None,\n",
        "                'Test Accuracy': round(base_acc, 4), 'Test Macro-F1': round(base_f1, 4), 'Time (s)': None})\n",
        "comp = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
        "comp"
      ],
      "id": "Ac4QzWmBe_4W"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
